# InfronixWeb Digital Marketing

> We create beautiful websites, help businesses show up on Google, set up instant automatic replies for customer messages, and run online ads that bring in paying customers. Based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

InfronixWeb is a dedicated web design and digital marketing agency based in Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We help local and global businesses grow by creating easy-to-use websites, helping businesses appear at the top of Google searches, setting up automatic WhatsApp and website customer assistants, and running online ads that attract real buyers.

## 2. What We Do (Our Services)

### A. Website Creation
We make clean, attractive, and simple-to-use websites for businesses of all sizes. Every website looks great and works smoothly on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers.
- **Business Websites**: Simple and multi-page websites for companies, consultants, shops, and service providers.
- **Online Stores**: Product showcases where your customers can browse items, add them to a shopping cart, and pay safely online.
- **Fast Loading**: Quick pages so your visitors never have to wait.
- **Easy Contact**: Clear buttons and simple inquiry forms so visitors can call, email, or message you in one tap.

### B. Showing Up on Google
We help your business appear at the top when potential customers search on Google and Google Maps.
- **Top Google Positions**: Helping people discover your business before your competitors.
- **Local City Search**: Making sure nearby customers in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and across India find your location easily.
- **More Daily Visitors**: Attracting people who are actively looking to buy what you sell.

### C. Automatic Customer Replies & WhatsApp Help
We set up smart automatic reply systems so your business never misses a customer question or sales inquiry, even when you are asleep or busy.
- **24/7 Website Assistant**: Greets visitors on your website, answers common questions, and collects their phone number and inquiry.
- **Instant WhatsApp Messages**: Automatically sends price lists, brochures, and answers directly to customers on WhatsApp.
- **Saves Your Time**: Takes care of routine questions automatically so you can focus on running your business.

### D. Online Ads & Social Media Growth
We run targeted online campaigns designed to bring in real inquiries and help you sell more products and services.
- **Instagram & Facebook Ads**: Showing your offers directly to the people most likely to buy from you.
- **Google Search Ads**: Putting your business at the very top of Google when people search for your services.
- **Social Media Management**: Posting regular updates, photos, and announcements to keep your followers engaged and build trust.

---

## 3. How We Work
1. **Free Initial Consultation**: You share your business goals, target audience, and requirements with our team.
2. **Custom Plan & Proposal**: We prepare a tailored proposal suited specifically for your business needs and timeline.
3. **Creation & Review**: We build your website, set up your messaging assistants, or launch your campaigns with regular progress updates.
4. **Launch & Ongoing Growth**: Everything goes live, and we continue providing support to help your business succeed online.

1. **Direct Communication**: You talk directly with the people working on your project — no confusing middlemen or long delays.

4. **All in One Place**: From building your website and getting found on Google to automatic customer replies and ads, we handle everything for you.
